= Backlog execution round 63 — 2026-11-05 =

== Android consolidation — offline HTML5 launcher ==

Following the user's resolved order and target, phase 2 is a **separate offline
Android WebView/catalog app** for all 89 current `public/apps/*/index.html`
entrypoints. The Riseup × InviZible VPN-specific scaffold was not repurposed.
The Android app uses minSdk 24, target/compile SDK 34, Java 17, and a debug build
from CI; the local workspace has no Android SDK/Gradle/JDK.

The source is in `apps/html5-offline-launcher/`. Gradle calls
`scripts/build-html5-offline-launcher-assets.mjs` to stage each entrypoint's
whole app directory into the ignored build folder and generate a catalog. The
repo retains one canonical copy of the app corpus. The current pack set is
8,030 files / 147,970,584 uncompressed bytes; the one sibling data directory
without an `index.html` is excluded. Each app has a distinct synthetic HTTPS
origin under `.invalid`; the catalog has a separate origin. The manifest has no
INTERNET permission, the WebViewClient serves only packaged assets, and
external navigation/network requests are denied.

A static scan of the 89 entrypoint HTML files found an external script tag in
`anc-studio` for a Tailwind browser CDN. This is flagged in the catalog; that
resource and any other runtime network features will be blocked. This is not a
comprehensive dependency audit and is not a claim that every individual app is
fully functional offline. Downloads and camera/microphone/location permissions
are not delegated.

`docs/html5-offline-launcher-v1-implementation-2026-11-05.md` records the
architecture, limitations, and build path. The pull-request workflow uploads a
debug APK artifact rather than committing a large generated binary. CI build
and resulting APK size/hash are pending.
